findings.message: There is no 3.2.S Drug Substance leaf in the original IND (sequence 0001, its first sequence), and no cross-reference on record covers 3.2.S with a Letter of Authorization on file. An initial IND carries its chemistry, manufacturing and controls information (21 CFR 312.23(a)(7)), or incorporates it by reference to a file whose holder has authorized it (21 CFR 312.23(b)). To clear this, place Module 3 from the CMC module (CMC / Module 3, "Place into the submission"), or record the cross-reference to the Drug Master File that holds 3.2.S, naming 3.2.S among its sections, with its Letter of Authorization on file (Module 1.4.1).
